name: has_high_qs_education
description: Founder has at least one education with QS ranking 6 or better
expression: lambda founder: any(parse_qs(e.get('qs_ranking', '')) <= 6 for e in founder.get('educations', []))

name: industry_in_tech_or_health
description: Founder industry is in Technology or Healthcare
expression: lambda founder: founder.get('industry', '').lower() in ['technology, information & internet platforms', 'medical equipment manufacturing', 'clinical & diagnostic healthcare', 'healthcare']

name: has_executive_experience
description: Founder has held a senior or executive role
expression: lambda founder: any(role.lower() in ['president', 'ceo', 'co-founder', 'founder', 'director', 'vp', 'principal', 'chief', 'senior director', 'executive', 'manager'] for job in founder.get('jobs', []) for role in [job.get('role', '')])

name: has_ipo_or_acquisition
description: Founder has been involved in an IPO or acquisition

name: has_graduate_degree
description: Founder holds at least one graduate degree
expression: lambda founder: any(e.get('degree', '')).lower() in ['mba', 'ms', 'phd', 'fellowship', 'master', 'jd', 'mba'] for e in founder.get('educations', [])

name: has_long_term_experience
description: Founder has held a role for more than 9 years
expression: lambda founder: any(parse_duration(job.get('duration', '')) > 9 for job in founder.get('jobs', []))

name: experienced_in_software_or_it
description: Founder has experience in software or IT industry
expression: lambda founder: any(founder.get('industry', '').lower() in ['software development', 'it services & digital solutions', 'technology, information & internet platforms'])

name: industry_known
description: Founder industry is known and recognized as a startup industry
expression: lambda founder: founder.get('industry', '').lower() in ['software development', 'internet media & publishing', 'technology, information & internet platforms', 'healthcare', 'biotech & nanotech', 'education & training services']

name: has_education_in_ranked_institution
description: Founder studied at an institution with QS rank 50 or better
expression: lambda founder: any(parse_qs(e.get('qs_ranking', '')) <= 50 for e in founder.get('educations', []))

name: has_public_experience
description: Founder has held a public or academic role
expression: lambda founder: any(role.lower() in ['professor', 'lecturer', 'researcher', 'educator', 'professor', 'visiting executive', 'board member', 'chairman', 'director'] for job in founder.get('jobs', []) for role in [job.get('role', '')])

name: industry_has_ipo
description: Industry has had at least one IPO event

name: industry_has_acquisition
description: Industry has had at least one acquisition event

name: founder_has_bachelor_or_higher
description: Founder has at least a bachelor degree
expression: lambda founder: any(parse_qs(e.get('qs_ranking', '')) <= 200 for e in founder.get('educations', []))

name: industry_in_health_or_biotech
description: Founder industry is in Healthcare or Biotechnology
expression: lambda founder: founder.get('industry', '').lower() in ['biotechnology & nanotechnology research', 'clinical & diagnostic healthcare', 'healthcare', 'medical equipment manufacturing']

name: has_experience_in_startup_roles
description: Founder has held roles typical in startups
expression: lambda founder: any(role.lower() in ['co-founder', 'founder', 'president', 'ceo', 'coo', 'cto', 'vp', 'director'] for job in founder.get('jobs', []) for role in [job.get('role', '')])

name: industry_has_long_history
description: Founder has been active in the industry for more than 9 years
expression: lambda founder: any(parse_duration(job.get('duration', '')) > 9 for job in founder.get('jobs', []))

name: founder_has_multidisciplinary_education
description: Founder has education in multiple fields
expression: lambda founder: len({e.get('field', '').lower() for e in founder.get('educations', [])}) > 1
